entries.42517f64fa5d2ac1: This business sells prescription pharmaceuticals to hospitals and clinics in Japan through the company and its subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥123.5 billion (up 25.0% from the previous year). The increase was due to recording 7 months of sales from Torii Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., which became a consolidated subsidiary in September 2025, and to jointly promoting priority products with it. Drugs for acute respiratory infections were ¥33.8 billion (down 34.8% year on year), with the anti-novel coronavirus drug Xocova decreasing and the anti-influenza virus drug Xofluza increasing. The insomnia drug Quviviq was ¥2.6 billion (up 224.1% year on year), and in March 2026 sales of the depression drug Zazubei began.

entries.e26aedae65c4dfc6: This is sales of prescription pharmaceuticals through overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Europe and China, and through exports. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥65.0 billion (up 9.9% year on year). The U.S. business was ¥28.7 billion (up 22.9% year on year) and the European business was ¥20.8 billion (up 23.4% year on year), with the antibacterial cefiderocol (product name Fetroja in the U.S. and Fetcroja in Europe) performing well in both. The China business was ¥6.2 billion (down 28.3% year on year), as generic pharmaceuticals declined due to the impact of policies to restrain medical expenses.

entries.e5275b768985a9c6: This business conducts research and development, purchasing, manufacturing and sales of prescription pharmaceuticals prescribed at hospitals, and related operations; the entire group is 1 business. Because the company has a single prescription pharmaceuticals segment, disclosure by [[term:segment|segment]] is omitted. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥499,677 million (¥499.7 billion, up 14.0% from the previous year). Here, the 4 revenue sources that the company uses to explain its operating results are arranged in descending order of amount. The group consists of 39 consolidated subsidiaries, 6 affiliates and 2 joint ventures (as of March 31, 2026).
